data.body: Duplicate — already fixed on main by e548 (aaf71639b8, "e548: drive /rerun 502 guard via TestClient"), which landed after this worktree's base commit (c89a2ddcc4) and so was invisible when this was filed. That change replaced the hand-rolled SimpleNamespace request with a real TestClient drive, which is a strictly better fix than the one proposed here. Verified: `git log --oneline --grep=rerun` on the merged main shows aaf71639b8 with the identical AttributeError in its root-cause statement. Closing as duplicate; no work remains.
